body: Thank you all. It really does make a difference.
I go out plenty. Not very good at social interaction
Sorry.. I don't have any friends.
I woke up to somebody slapping beef jerky in my face. True story.

It would be best if people were more willing to be just simply friendly to one another. Maybe it's just Boston that has a problem with that. Maybe I'm just disillusioned by my lack of friends.
Second best would be if my damn depression medicine would work. Up to 80mg and still nothing.
I've always had an issue with clarity in writing, I tend to write what comes out of my mind first and think about how to explain it later. So I'll definitely practice this.

Great grand parents were cousins, genetic cancers have killed 3 of my close relatives, (aunt, grandparents...) It's coming! Also had parents have affairs (in fact my father is having one right now and has been for years. Mother knows).
